name: Retromine
description:
About This Game

DIG TO THE CORE OF THE EARTH

Retromine is an ultra-satisfying, highly replayable, tough-as-nails deckbuilding roguelike. Delve into the caves, mine resources, and escape before the caverns collapse! Spend ore to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and discover powerful synergies on your way to the bottom of the world.

PLAY CARDS, MINE RESOURCES

SPEND YOUR ORE, POWER UP

CREATE EARTH-SHATTERING COMBOS

A FRESH TAKE

Retromine is a brand new roguelike deckbuilding experience for fans who love the genre, but find their favorite games growing stale.

GAMEPLAY

  • Roguelike deckbuilding: Delve into the mines, play cards to mine resources, and escape with your life - then use those resources to buy new cards, upgrade your deck, and power up!

  • Strike a perfect balance: Survive by mining scorium to narrowly escape danger, get stronger by mining ore to buy new cards

  • Discover powerful synergies: Unearth super-powered synergies and exploit game breaking combos

  • Test your mettle: Challenge yourself and put your decision making and problem solving abilities to the test

  • Enter flow state: Unwind with an experience expressly created to place you in a state of meditative deep focus

FEATURES

  • Dig your way to mastery: Collect over 100 unique resource, tool, action, and ability cards to use on your expeditions

  • Shape your run: Harness the strengths of over 10 unique power cards to change the way you play

  • Unlock passive abilities: Play ability cards to gain impactful passives that transform gameplay to suit your playstyle

  • Immerse yourself: Tunnel through a curious subterranean fantasy beneath a classic retro-pixel aesthetic

  • Dreamy, hypnotic synthwave: Relax with over 40 minutes of soothing synthwave music by Airglow

DIG, DIE, LEARN, REPEAT!

Enjoy infinite procedurally generated content in a game specifically designed for endless replayability.
